description:
USE WHEN you want one query box over Sato Hub, the daily-rebuilt index of what onchain and crypto AI agents are built from (frameworks, MCP servers, wallets, x402 and stablecoin payment rails, data tools), plus its dated answers, agent-economy numbers and wiki. Not for token prices, trading or investment advice.
NOT FOR filtered or paginated directory queries (use onchain_agent_search_resources instead) or registered agents (use onchain_agent_search_agents).

RETURNS (json): { results: [{ id, title, url }] }, at most 10, best first, from one query string; url is the canonical satohub.ai page to cite. Pass an id to `fetch` for the full text. A query nothing matches returns results: [] — never padded with unrelated records — plus scope_note, what Sato Hub covers. Read-only.

Examples: "coinbase agentkit", "x402 payment rails on Base", "how many ERC-8004 agents by chain", "MCP servers that answer".

query.description: What to look for, in plain words: a project name, a chain, a standard, or a question about building onchain agents. Matched on its first 200 characters.

name: search

about_url.description: Only with identity_note: the satohub.ai page that says what Sato Hub is.

identity_note.description: Only when a search for the Sato name itself matched nothing: Sato Hub's no-token statement. Not a result.

results.description: At most 10 matches, best first. Empty when nothing matches — never padded.

url.description: The canonical satohub.ai page to cite.

scope_note.description: Only when nothing matched: what Sato Hub covers and how to ask it. Not a result; results stays empty.

title: Search Sato Hub
